summary.text: Deon T. Tedder is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 42, which covers Charleston and Dorchester Counties.
His Senate service began in 2023, and his committees include Judiciary and Labor, Commerce and Industry.

paragraphs.text: Tedder was born on April 26, 1990, in Durham, North Carolina, and is an attorney.
His official page lists a B.A. from S.C. State University in 2012 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 2015.
He served in the S.C. House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023 and has served in the Senate since 2023.
His committee assignments are Family and Veterans' Services, Judiciary, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Medical Affairs.
